title: docs: say safety checks read input text only
author: greysonmiller67-lang

gist.summary: Updated gen.pollinations.ai’s safety documentation to clarify that safety checks inspect request text only. The `X-Safety-Applied` header does not indicate that generated output was inspected; apps that must exclude all nudity should moderate the generated output themselves.
